chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from Ali ibn Asbat from Ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who divorces his wife with two divorces, then divorces her with the third while he is ill. He said: She inherits him.

key_terms.تَطلِيقَتَينِ: Two divorces (referring to the first two revocable divorces)

ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit if her husband divorces her three times while he is sick?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies that a triple divorce (*talaq al-thalathah*) pronounced by a husband during his final illness (*marad al-mawt*) does not sever the wife's inheritance rights, as the divorce is not yet fully effective until death. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential distinction between the finality of the marital bond and the preservation of financial rights during the critical period of impending death, ensuring the wife receives her share of the estate despite the irrevocable nature of the divorce.
